name: context
title: Context
description: Tell a chat's bots what's open on this server's computer: the front app and window, apps, windows, browser tabs, prompts, devices and the network.

tools.name: summary
tools.description: One reading of this computer: the front app and window, how long since someone last used it, native prompts on screen, every running app and window, every browser tab, devices nearby and the network. Read-only; nothing is opened or focused.

tools.name: apps
tools.description: Running apps with pid and window count, the front one starred; or every installed app with installed: true.

installed.description: List installed apps instead of running ones.

tools.name: windows
tools.description: Open windows with app, pid, window id and title, the front one starred. Pass the pid and window id to Computer Use.

app.description: Only windows of apps whose name or bundle id contains this.

tools.name: tabs
tools.description: Every open browser tab, by browser window, with title, URL and tab id, the showing tab starred.

query.description: Only tabs whose title or URL contains this.

tools.name: dialogs
tools.description: Whether native sheets, dialogs or system prompts are showing in up to four visible windows. Reports presence only, never their text. Needs cua-driver.

app.description: Only check apps whose name contains this.

tools.name: devices
tools.description: Tailscale peers, Bluetooth devices (connected, nearby or out of range) and displays.

tools.name: network
tools.description: The network interface, Wi-Fi name, IP address, and whether it's an iPhone hotspot. Takes a few seconds.
